email.body1:
Keith, saw Nue launched Credit and Commit Burndown and is expanding AI across the revenue lifecycle platform.

As the platform alliances surface grows, partner-sourced pipeline usually outpaces what the team can cover account by account, and that is where co-sell deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nue's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

email.body2:
Keith, quick follow-up for Nue.

Co-selling at scale breaks down when nobody has time to personalize outreach into each partner's book, so warm intros never convert to meetings. Automating that first touch is where partner-sourced pipeline actually compounds.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body3:
Keith, last bit of proof for Nue.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nue's reply rate likely compares to other revenue-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keith, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and an expansion push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your alliances motion? I'll tailor it to Nue either way.
